owns: Unambiguous provider-transaction to Forecast-event identity. A match requires an explicit payee alias + mapped Atlas account + direction + an allowed scheduled/posting-date relation, or — for the named fixed Tennis BC salary streams only — a uniquely proven transfer credit into BILLS (chequing-a) + direction + an allowed scheduled/posting-date relation. Optional payeeExcludePatterns refuse a hit that also matches a reimbursement or other excluded alias. Same-day is the default; named automatic payments may opt into weekend-to-next-business-day; a payment onto a mapped card may cover the latest due on or before posting. Amount similarity is not identity. After that identity is unique, a card extra payment may settle the min only when the observed credit is at least the scheduled due. Named fixed salary streams additionally require the exact scheduled amount as a necessary guard; that amount is not identity by itself. A TENNIS BC payee credit on a household account is not salary identity. A TENNIS INCOME deposit or reimbursement is not household-cash posting proof. An unrelated household transfer is not salary identity.
does_not_own: Permission to write plan.opening or representedEvents onto data.json, pending-to-posted proof, or a second event engine.
